parts.t: MOI-1A and Pathfinder: computing in orbit
items: Orbital computing satellite (first Indian orbital computing satellite)
Pathfinder: India's first orbital data-centre satellite
Orbital data-centre satellite (first Indian orbital data-centre satellite)
Run AI models and process data in orbit
**Orbital data centre:** a space-based computing system in which satellites carry high-performance processors such as data-centre-class GPUs.
**In orbit:** AI models can run directly in orbit, and data can be processed closer to where it is generated.
**Benefit:** reduces dependence on transmitting large volumes of raw satellite data to ground-based data centres.

items: **Aim of the constellation:** cellular broadband connectivity directly to smartphones.

Space Weather Observations at L1 to Advance Readiness–1
**Observation:** solar activity and its effects on the space environment.
**Early warning:** of solar events that may affect technological infrastructure and space missions.
**Data:** transmitted to NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC), which uses it to issue forecasts, watches, warnings and alerts.
At least 10 grams from Phobos (sample-return target)
First sample return from the Martian system
**Modules:** three spacecraft modules: propulsion, exploration and return.
**Power and propulsion:** solar panels provide electricity; chemical propulsion is used for manoeuvres.
**Orbit:** the spacecraft will use a quasi-satellite orbit around Mars near Phobos.

**Guidance:** the demonstration used satellite-derived guidance instead of a conventional Instrument Landing System (ILS).

parts.t: Indigenous semiconductor and Gallium Nitride technology
items: **13 May 2026:** SAMEER and ISRO's ISTRAC agreed to develop X-band deep-space communication amplifiers using indigenous GaN chips from GAETEC, DRDO.
**SSPL:** developed indigenous processes for manufacturing 4-inch Silicon Carbide wafers; fabricated GaN HEMTs and MMICs.
**GAETEC, Hyderabad:** limited production capability for indigenous GaN-on-SiC MMICs was established here.

**iDEX (Innovations for Defence Excellence):** a contract was signed with Agnit Semiconductors Private Limited to develop advanced GaN semiconductors for next-generation defence wireless transmitters.
**Defence systems:** radar systems, electronic warfare systems, communication systems, and radar transmitters and electronic warfare jammers.
**Other uses:** intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR); unmanned systems; space, aerospace, 5G and satellite communications.
**Delivery:** the engine was successfully realised and delivered to GTRE on 22 July 2026.
**Significance:** described as a step towards reducing dependence on imported compact propulsion systems, subject to successful testing and production approval.

lectures.title: Government apps and digital applications in news

items: Ministry of Panchayati Raj, NIC and DigiHaat
Enables citizens and organisations to donate verified digital-equipment bundles directly to eligible Gram Panchayats.
Access to Panchayat finances, plans, development works, public assets, participation and grievance-redressal tools. Integrated with DigiHaat for DAANVEER.
Facilitates Panchayat planning, budgeting, accounting, progress reporting, asset management and online payments.
Uses AI to convert recordings of Gram Sabha and Panchayat meetings into structured, reviewable minutes.
Uses GIS for spatial planning and decision support in preparing and implementing Gram Panchayat Development Plans.
Census 2027 will use enumerator mobile applications on Android and iOS for digital data collection while retaining house-to-house visits.
Allows households to submit information online before an enumerator's visit. The generated Self-Enumeration ID helps confirm submitted information.
**Launch:** 29 July 2026 at Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi, by Ministry of Panchayati Raj Secretary Vivek Bharadwaj.
**How it works:** donors can select pre-approved computer bundles through DigiHaat; bundles are mapped to State-specific technical specifications.
**Aim:** designed to bridge the digital infrastructure gap in Gram Panchayats and strengthen local institutions.
Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda
Citizen-facing digital health platform and Personal Health Record (PHR) application
**Origin:** developed by the Government of India during the COVID-19 pandemic.
**Use:** contact tracing, risk awareness and citizen engagement; a national digital public good.
**Gateway:** single digital gateway for accessing health services.
**Records:** personal health records for individuals and families; health-record management.
**ABDM:** access to ABDM-enabled services; ABHA creation.
**Scan and Register:** facility for hospital registration.
**AI:** AI-assisted digitisation of medical records, including laboratory reports.
**PM-JAY Wallet:** shows total healthcare coverage, amount used and family-wise consumption.
**Hospital search:** search for PM-JAY empanelled hospitals offering cashless treatment.
